hooks.command: changed=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'fullburn/' || true); report=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'fullburn/reports/ADVERSARY_REPORT' || true); if [ "$changed" -gt 0 ] && [ "$report" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Reminder (ENGINE_BUILD.md Law 9 / §10.3): fullburn/ has uncommitted changes but no adversary report was touched. Nothing is done until the engine-adversary subagent returns a PASS report in reports/ and its deterministic tests are green in CI. The builder never grades its own work.'; fi
